description: Source code for oseama utility, which handles reading, creating, and extracting entities from Seama seal (container) files, including parsing headers, managing metadata, and computing MD5 checksums.

methods.name: oseama_info
methods.description: Displays information about a Seama seal file, including metadata entries and entity details.

methods.name: oseama_entity
methods.description: Creates or modifies a Seama entity within a seal file, allowing addition of metadata and payload data.

methods.name: oseama_extract
methods.description: Extracts a specific entity from a Seama seal file to an output file.
